title: Browser URL Expander For Kamailio Resources
html:
Those spending a lot of time navigating through Kamailio project web resources, the KSR-URL-Expander browser extension could be useful.

It works with all major browsers based on Chromium (e.g., Chrome, Brave) and Firefox, enabling to jump quickly to various web pages based on keywords introduced in the address bar.

By typing a few characters, the browser can go to module documentation (for stable or development branches), to wiki and the cookbooks for core, variables or transformations (again for latest branches) as well as to github project pages, or trigger google searches on kamailio.org or lists.kamailio.org sites.

The KSR-URL-Expander project is available at:

  • https://github.com/miconda/KSR-URL-Expander

The readme contains the installation and usage instructions. The next gif shows the experience to go to the readme of a module:

Enjoy!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
